name: AdvGLUE
description: Adversarial variant of GLUE benchmark designed to evaluate robustness of NLP models. Includes adversarially crafted examples that fool standard models to test true understanding rather than pattern matching.
reputation: Important benchmark for evaluating model robustness against adversarial perturbations
notes: Tests robustness by using carefully crafted adversarial examples. Significant performance drop from standard GLUE indicates vulnerability to adversarial attacks.
